title: Make Great Coffee with a Moka Pot
summary: ChefSteps shows how to make espresso-style coffee in a moka pot, with a bonus latte hack. It is a quick how-to aimed at home brewers.
why: HN commenters link it in moka pot threads as a practical guide whose tips, such as starting with hot water, improved their coffee.

quote.text: There's a great video with coffee expert James Hoffmann on making coffee in a moka pot
